name: Point sets without an empty convex hexagon (rediscovering 29 points)
description: construct() -> list of 1..30 distinct integer points [x, y] with |x|, |y| <= 10^6 and no three collinear. No six points may form a convex hexagon with no other point inside (exact search over all convex chains anchored at their lowest vertex). Maximize the number of points; the optimum is 29. Overmars found 29-point sets without empty hexagons and Heule and Scheucher proved every 30-point set has one, so 29 is optimal.

sources.locator: Marijn J. H. Heule and Manfred Scheucher, Happy Ending: An Empty Hexagon in Every Set of 30 Points (2024). Crossref records inspected for Heule-Scheucher (TACAS 2024) and Overmars (Discrete Comput. Geom. 2003); Erdős Problem #216 page inspected: g(5) = 10 (Harborth), empty hexagons exist in large sets (Nicolás; Gerken), g(6) = 30 (Heule and Scheucher), and no g(k) for k >= 7 (Horton). Overmars found 29-point sets without empty hexagons and Heule and Scheucher proved every 30-point set has one, so 29 is optimal.
Erdős Problem #216 (disproved (no g(k) for k >= 7); g(6) = 30); statement, history and current bounds reviewed 2026-09-24.
JSP-000198; pinned discovery source, independently paraphrased. Primary mathematical attribution follows the papers above.
